verification: signer thumbprint and publisher match protected manifest
certificate chain and revocation checks succeed
failure: Any absent, invalid, untrusted, expired-without-valid-timestamp, revoked, wrong-publisher, wrong-thumbprint, wrong-hash or unverifiable signature denies installation/startup.
custody: Operational certificate selection, provisioning, access grant, use and revocation are separate Owner Human Gates. No runtime service may read/export the private key.
